question_cn: 下列哪种情况最适合考虑走中间招？
question_en: Which situation is the best cue to look for an intermezzo?

options.text_cn: 己方刚刚吃掉对方一子，对方按顺序打算吃回——此时寻找插入一步将军或捉挂子的机会
options.text_en: You have just captured an enemy piece and expect a recapture; look for a chance to insert a check or an attack on a loose piece

options.text_cn: 双方子力均已离开开放线，局面完全封闭
options.text_en: Both sides' pieces have left the open files and the position is completely closed

options.text_cn: 己方子力全部有保护，对方无挂子，无将军机会
options.text_en: All your pieces are defended, and the opponent has no loose pieces or available checks

options.text_cn: 己方王已解将，对方无任何弱点
options.text_en: Your king is safe from check and the opponent has no weaknesses

explanation_cn: 中间招最佳触发条件：换子序列「该对方吃回」的那一拍——此时对方预期自己会安全吃回，警惕性最低。此时若有将军、捉挂子（对方有无根子）、捉悬空子等强迫步可走，就可以插入中间招，打乱对方节奏，净多赚先手收益。
explanation_en: The ideal moment is when the opponent expects to recapture during an exchange. If you can insert a forcing move, such as a check or an attack on a loose or undefended piece, the opponent must respond before the exchange continues, giving you an extra tempo and disrupting their plan.
